audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Skill for rows 2-6 while the content layer, packet chart and all the prose say Xerath out-ranges Viktor at every stage; row 1 said Xerath while content says Skill.
audit.why: Xerath Q 750 / W 1000 / E 1050 range vs Viktor E 525 origin — the range gap never closes; that is the lane's difficulty story (TRICKY 7/10).
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped to match the content/packet chart with grounded whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Xerath's R called 'Arcane Barrage' (really Rite of the Arcane) and Viktor's E called 'Death Ray' (really Hextech Ray) throughout content.
audit.why: Kit files are the authority; packet suspectNames flags Death Ray.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions: Gravity Field cancels Rite of the Arcane (channel), and Xerath's E/R can cancel Viktor's Chaos Storm channel. Neither was stated anywhere.
audit.why: enemyKit R has channel flag; ownerKit R has channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it').
audit.corrected: Both added to breakdown.cooldowns with cooldown numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Replaced with bodies matching their titles.

edits.before: Xerath
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online, but his Q still reaches further — laser the wave from max range and dodge sideways; neither side commits yet.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: His full artillery kit is up: 750-range Q plus the 1050-range Shocking Orb stun punish every step to the wave.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: His artillery keeps you off the wave through 4-5 — take the CS that is safe, bank Manaflow, and give up poke, not HP.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane snipes from a screen away — never sit low in lane. Your storm matters in ganks, not the poke war.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: Both spike at Luden's, but his range edge stays — he pokes first in every rotation; look for roams off your shove.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: He still out-ranges you — never duel the poke war; group, dodge the line shots, and reach him with W once a fight starts.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Gravity Field for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E, 13s rank 1): his only CC — dodge it and his artillery never converts. Step up in that window. - His R is a channel: drop Gravity Field on him to cancel Rite of the Arcane. His stun cancels your storm — cast R after his E is spent.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Every step to a minion eats an Arcanopulse — cast Q on the wave first so the answering beam lands on shield, not health bar.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Your shove-and-roam is the escape from a lost poke lane — but chase past river vision and his 5000-range R ends the story.

edits.before: Xerath's Arcanopulse out-ranges your Death Ray from level 1, poking you for free.
edits.after: Xerath's Arcanopulse out-ranges your Hextech Ray from level 1, poking you for free.

edits.before: At 6 Arcane Barrage zones and snipes you from a screen away with no counterplay.
edits.after: At 6 Rite of the Arcane zones and snipes you from a screen away as you have no dash.

edits.before: Xerath out-ranges you at every level: his Arcanopulse (Q) and Eye of Destruction (W) reach further than Death Ray, so he pokes you off the wave for free and you can't answer without walking into his range. His Shocking Orb (E) stun punishes any step up, so farming safely is your only play.
edits.after: Xerath out-ranges you at every level: his Arcanopulse (Q) and Eye of Destruction (W) reach further than Hextech Ray, so he pokes you off the wave for free and you can't answer without walking into his range. His Shocking Orb (E) stun punishes any step up, so farming safely is your only play.

edits.before: Arcane Barrage (R) lets him zone you from a screen away and snipe you under tower or set up ganks, so his level 6 pressure is brutal against a dashless champion. Never sit at low HP in his ult range and hold Gravity Field for the gank follow-up.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane (R) lets him zone you from a screen away and snipe you under tower or set up ganks, so his level 6 pressure is brutal against a dashless champion. Never sit at low HP in his ult range and hold Gravity Field for the gank follow-up.

edits.before: Even into two-plus items he out-ranges your Death Ray and Chaos Storm, so you can't win a straight poke war; your only path is to survive lane, roam or group, and force fights where you dodge his skillshots and reach him.
edits.after: Even into two-plus items he out-ranges your Hextech Ray and Chaos Storm, so you can't win a straight poke war; your only path is to survive lane, roam or group, and force fights where you dodge his skillshots and reach him.

edits.before: Level 1-2 already favour Xerath: his Arcanopulse simply reaches further than your Death Ray, so he chunks you whenever you move to last-hit and you can't trade back. Play for safe CS, hug your tower line, and don't give him a free stun angle with his Shocking Orb. Accept that you're the scaling side here and give up poke rather than HP.
edits.after: Level 1-2 already favour Xerath: his Arcanopulse simply reaches further than your Hextech Ray, so he chunks you whenever you move to last-hit and you can't trade back. Play for safe CS, hug your tower line, and don't give him a free stun angle with his Shocking Orb. Accept that you're the scaling side here and give up poke rather than HP.

edits.before: Xerath keeps his range edge into first and second item, so a straight poke war stays lost — even evolved Death Ray and Chaos Storm out-range less than his artillery kit. Your win condition is to survive the lane, roam to sidelanes, and group for fights where you dodge his line skillshots and close the gap with Gravity Field. Don't try to out-poke him; instead punish his lack of escape once you or your team reach him.
edits.after: Xerath keeps his range edge into first and second item, so a straight poke war stays lost — even evolved Hextech Ray and Chaos Storm out-range less than his artillery kit. Your win condition is to survive the lane, roam to sidelanes, and group for fights where you dodge his line skillshots and close the gap with Gravity Field. Don't try to out-poke him; instead punish his lack of escape once you or your team reach him.

edits.before: Snipe you with Arcane Barrage under tower or during ganks
edits.after: Snipe you with Rite of the Arcane under tower or in ganks

Missing interactions (mutual channel cancels) folded into breakdown.cooldowns. All three lint findings fixed. winCon/tldr claim 'own every fight from two items on' sits oddly against a lane Xerath out-ranges forever, but grouping/reaching him late is genuinely Viktor-favoured, so left.
